source.source_type: public preservation mirror; EOD option quote snapshots

price_basis.qqq_options: raw nominal QQQ close and actual listed strikes

contract_selection.expiry: closest eligible 20-40 DTE expiry to 30 DTE

rules.entry_exit_timing: select actual contracts at close t; t+1 may reprice only those exact contract IDs from t+1 quotes; if either is missing/invalid, skip without substitution. Exit signal at t closes no earlier than next observed session. EOD-side prices are proxies, not fill proof.

paired_nav_diagnostic.baseline_definition: same initial capital: 42% QQQ adjusted-close total-return proxy plus 58% fixed cash; no option overlay

scenarios.performance_gate: BLOCKED: EOD mirror is not confirmed fills; chain gaps and source cutoff make daily portfolio path incomplete

trade_attribution.classification_note: entry/exit regime and 20-session raw-spot momentum are post-hoc diagnostic strata only; spread buckets use max leg spread/midpoint <=10%, <=25%, >25%; none is a trade rule.

interpretation: Only closed-spread event P&L is summarized. It is a quote-side proxy under explicit hypothetical costs, not confirmed fills. CAGR, daily MTM MaxDD, Sharpe, ES95 are intentionally NULL because the observation path is incomplete and EOD snapshots do not prove fills.
